publication.title: Integrating Faceted Search with Data Analytic Tools in the User Interface of ParliamentSampo – Parliament of Finland on the Semantic Web

adjudication.basis: The report describes ParliamentSampo speeches/people perspectives, interactive facets, instance inspection, and analytical views over parliamentary RDF knowledge graphs.

tasks: Approx.3,000 users in10 days after launch; no recruited trial

descriptions.interaction: Faceted search and browsing over speech/people perspectives, instance pages, and coordinated analytical tabs.
descriptions.guidance: Perspective-based and facet-based narrowing; no ranked recommendation or personalization established in this report.
descriptions.visualisation: Tables, timelines, histograms/pie charts, maps, heatmaps, and migration arcs.
descriptions.backend: Parliamentary Linked Open Data with SPARQL endpoint; declarative Sampo-UI configuration and reusable components.
descriptions.evaluation: Illustrative usage scenarios and reported deployment adoption

resources.notes: README explicitly identifies Sampo-UI as the semantic-portal UI framework; source listing and deployment documentation are visible.
Saved page has emptytitle/description,root div and hashed app bundle; reported host is present but current ParliamentSampo identity is not visible in HTML.
